svg.desc: CEZ Job Finder mark, bare blackbird, cut for 32 px and below (site header, browser tab): mark.svg's skeleton at one eighth, edges on whole pixels at 16 px - head r6 at 20,8, breast r8 at 16,18, band 3 px tall at 16 px, legs 1 px wide, beak 2 px deep w/ its point at 31,8, back + band under-edge on whole-pixel diagonals, eye 1 px, no pupil. Contract (app/docs/desktop-icon.md; app/web/assets.py reads it): viewBox 0 0 32 32, shapes (path, circle, rect, ellipse or polygon) direct children of the svg, one per line, each w/ class first - ink, beak, eye - and its fill as a lowercase attribute: ink #000000, beak + eye #ffe433; no id, style, transform, defs or group. Dark cut is derived, never drawn: ink => the page's text tone, eye => the page colour, beak stays.
